candidates.description: These tokens represent Portuguese and Spanish adverbial suffixes and related morphosyntactic variants used to form adverbs and nouns.
This vector represents relative pronouns and conjunctions across Romance and related languages.
This vector represents common short phonetic suffixes or syllable endings in names and words.
This vector represents the concept of quantifying degree, extent, or magnitude across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents academic, scientific, and historical branches of knowledge and study.
These tokens represent grammatical prepositions across Romance languages like Spanish and Italian.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing roots related to Latin, historical, and ecclesiastical terms, as well as grammatical prefixes and inflections.
This feature vector activates strongly on common Spanish verbs and grammatical suffixes related to action and time.
This vector represents common Spanish nouns used in frequent adverbial and prepositional locutions.
This feature vector activates on directional, spatial, or anatomical relational terms, particularly those ending in comparative suffixes like "-terior" or "-rior".
